import json,subprocess,sys,shutil
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
run='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v12';batch='resumed-low-v12-auto-1-20261025';commit='bff7ef44e4c5bedd10dd1754cec7d1bb8ee06461'
state_path=ROOT/f'runtime/resume-low-20261025/publisher-{run}.json';state=read_json(state_path)
assert state['status']=='stopped_requires_reconciliation_no_image_replay' and state['last_checkpoint_requests']==0
assert len(state['checkpoints'])==1 and state['checkpoints'][0]['commit']==commit and state['checkpoints'][0]['completed_requests_at_snapshot']==16
assert not (state_path.parent/'publisher.lock').exists() and not (ROOT/'runtime/production-publish.lock').exists()
publication=ROOT/f'runtime/checkpoint-{batch}.json';prior=read_json(publication);assert prior['commit']==commit
failures=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures';failures.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
saved=[]
for source,suffix in [(state_path,'publisher-state'),(publication,'publication')]:
 target=failures/f'20261026-v12-first-network-failure-original-{suffix}.json';assert not target.exists()
 with target.open('xb') as f:f.write(source.read_bytes())
 assert file_sha256(target)==file_sha256(source)
 saved.append({'path':target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':file_sha256(target),'source_path':source.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()})
audit=failures/'20261026-v12-first-network-failure.json';assert not audit.exists()
write_json(audit,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'actual_old_unified_session':'93225','actual_old_exit_code':1,'fixed_commit':commit,'batch':batch,'preserved_original_bytes':saved,'network_failure':'Git push connection reset followed by failed localhost proxy connection; no image error or source replay. Normal Git connectivity later actually recovered.','scope':'Preserve original network failure before one bounded retry of the same immutable Git publication. No global proxy/TLS/account changes, force push, image call, canonical mutation or deadline reset.','source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
print(json.dumps({'failure_preserved':audit.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'same_commit_publication_retry_starting':commit,'new_image_calls':0}),flush=True)
result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(ROOT/'tools/production_checkpoint_publish.py'),commit,batch],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=2400)
assert result.returncode==0,(result.stdout,result.stderr)
receipt=read_json(publication);proof=read_json(ROOT/receipt['remote_original_readback'])
assert receipt['status']=='committed_pushed_and_originals_verified' and proof['status']=='verified' and proof['commit']==commit
assert read_json(state_path)==state,'Another publisher changed the failed state'
target=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261026-v12-first-publication-reconciled.json';assert not target.exists()
write_json(target,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'completed_at_utc':utc_now(),'fixed_commit':commit,'original_network_failure':audit.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'original_network_failure_sha256':file_sha256(audit),'actual_verified_readback':proof,'publication_receipt_sha256':file_sha256(publication),'checkpoint_requests':16,'new_original_PNGs':16,'scope':'Same immutable16-PNG snapshot ordinary-FF publication and complete pinned original-byte readback actually succeeded. No image replay, changed request, duplicate checkpoint, owner/deadline reset or new publisher yet.'})
state.update(status='reconciled_checkpoint_requires_same_run_continuation',last_checkpoint_requests=16,last_commit=commit,reconciled_at_utc=utc_now(),reconciliation=target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),reconciliation_sha256=file_sha256(target))
write_json(state_path,state)
print(json.dumps({'reconciled':True,'commit':commit,'actual_verified_at_utc':proof['completed_at_utc'],'checkpoint_requests':16,'publisher_running':False,'original_deadline_utc':state['original_deadline_utc']}),flush=True)
